# UIAspectRatioConstraint

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")`

Keeps its parent at a fixed aspect ratio, such as a square slot or a 16:9 picture, whatever the size of the window. It is applied after the parent's own `Size` and before its children are laid out.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AspectRatio` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The width divided by the height. 1 is a square, and 2 is twice as wide as it is tall. |
| `AspectType` | `Enum.AspectType` | `Enum.AspectType.FitWithinMaxSize` | read/write | Whether the ratio is fitted within the object's own size or scaled from its parent's size. |
| `DominantAxis` | `Enum.DominantAxis` | `Enum.DominantAxis.Width` | read/write | With `ScaleWithParentSize`: the axis that takes the parent's full extent. |
